name: NeuroTrader Lab
purpose: Historical-market strategy research, backtesting, agent evaluation, and paper-trading foundation.

modules.responsibility: Web UI, request orchestration, persistence, reports, scheduled commands.
modules.notes: Routes and controllers are the public PHP entry points.

modules.responsibility: FastAPI strategy registry, backtests, walk-forward evaluation, paper-signal calculation.
modules.notes: HTTP endpoints originate in app/main.py and app/routers/backtests.py.

modules.responsibility: CSV, Dukascopy and Twelve Data provider adapters; candle payloads, outage recovery state, and continuity-protected updates.
modules.notes: For live Dukascopy operations read market-data-continuity.md before changing scheduler or provider code.

modules.responsibility: Imports immutable official CFTC Gold COT records and creates versioned positioning features for dashboard/research use.
modules.notes: Phase 1 is explicitly non-decisional: it must not change strategy scoring, paper orders, or promotion gates until a timestamp-safe walk-forward A/B test is added.

modules.responsibility: Pair-owned AI Laboratory populations, adaptive parent frontier, semantic islands, archive memory, evaluation, champion lifecycle and mutation learning memory.
modules.notes: Read ai-learning-laboratory.md and adaptive-evolution.md before modifying laboratory code. Knowledge/civilization/theory modules remain available but run on a secondary monthly cadence.

modules.responsibility: Paper order/fill/evaluation records and the feedback-loop foundation.
modules.notes: Treat live-trading capability as unverified unless a task explicitly validates it.

change_log.change: Created compact Obsidian-compatible project-memory index from the current repository entry points.

Made pair-isolated AI Learning Laboratory the primary focus: bounded populations, daily incremental champion health checks, weekly full rolling evaluation, paper-order evidence and strict champion gates.
Added Dukascopy continuity protection: persistent pending ranges, retry state, market-open gap verification, recovery-first sync, generation block, and Market Data status UI.
Added CFTC Gold COT Phase 1: immutable raw reports, cot_v1 descriptive feature snapshots, Friday/Monday scheduler, and read-only Market Intelligence dashboard section.

Repaired the bounded GBPUSD 2005-01-18 H1 archive hole from the legacy Dukascopy source; optimized historical gap inspection and aligned PHP/Python closure calendars to prevent false full-validation hard-gates.

Aligned market-adaptive replay with the continuity gate: a complete GBPUSD archive beginning on 2005-01-02 is accepted for foundation evaluation instead of being rejected by a calendar-only start-year check.

Hardened laboratory parent selection against weak out-of-sample candidates, made mutation memory regime-scoped, and added forward-gate diagnostics to explain why a candidate cannot enter paper trading.

Added replay-only CSCV/PBO and per-trade Deflated Sharpe cohort diagnostics. Full-validation jobs now evaluate a selected generation cohort together, cache peer results to avoid duplicate replay work, and block statistically weak assessed candidates from paper trading.

Made differential-router and regime-ensemble identity authoritative across Python validation/registry and Laravel replay, paper, holdout, incremental, portfolio, and auto-training payloads; stale parent architecture metadata can no longer execute the wrong strategy family.

Added certified coverage passport v2 with explicit hierarchical evidence backoff, preserved fine-cell diagnostics, and bounded runtime-schema recovery for quarantined evaluator errors. Coverage, forward, paper, and portfolio gates remain fail-closed.

Added the adaptive parent ecosystem: governor-controlled dynamic parent K, exact semantic islands, convergence/diversity/young/failure archives, capability-level provenance, canonical multi-parent links, runtime WAIT policy, and parent-selection decision ledgers. Causal repair remains single-parent and all children retain independent replay/holdout/paper gates.

Hardened multi-agent runtime activation: independent-member metadata cannot bypass combined replay, portfolio proxies receive an attributed portfolio_sealed forward ledger and immutable identity hashes, stale proxy paper transport is blocked, and the lifecycle watchdog audits portfolio contract drift.

Hardened manual backtest idempotency against payload reuse, added baseline security headers and login throttling, made feed health canonical-provider-only, scoped paper uptime to the active provider, moved backup binaries into config-cache-safe configuration, and added scheduler runtime heartbeat plus strict operational probes.
Re-enabled canonical Market Reality analysis independently from frozen secondary intelligence, added a config-controlled H1-aligned freshness threshold, and refreshed production market snapshots.
Hardened PHPUnit isolation with forced SQLite memory variables and a pre-RefreshDatabase production-DB guard; made the paper-calibration FK migration idempotent for recovery/bootstrap runs.
Added fail-closed access-control and database-backup health checks: an active administrator and a SHA-256-verified, fresh SQL backup are now explicit operational prerequisites.

Aligned live market continuity with the historical quality session calendar so scheduled FX holiday closures cannot remain stuck as catching-up feed alerts; the regression suite now covers the Christmas boundary.

Made lifecycle monitoring evidence-anchored and schema-aware: it reuses lean model-version snapshots, bulk-checks forward/shadow contracts, and reports missing migrations without crashing or mutating promotion evidence.

Repaired first-generation root admission so parentless specialists use exact_group_root_default, aligned historical and live continuity calendars for FX holiday closures, and recovered clean bounded cohorts after quarantining invalid legacy lineage.

Added policy-aware reality-loop health for the intentional P0 secondary-intelligence freeze, added lab-pipeline lifecycle/queue boundary monitoring, and cleared the terminal timestamp when a screened generation enters full validation so active work cannot look completed.

Separated full-replay coverage checks into generation-frozen rolling and foundation manifests, prevented recovery dispatch without a sealed foundation archive, and aligned the PHP/Python XAU Sunday-open tolerance with the immutable Dukascopy research archive.

Included foundation dataset and actual rolling/foundation file hashes in the Python immutable replay cache identity, and fail-closed Laravel snapshot reuse when a frozen dataset hash no longer matches its file.

Added a shared configurable heavy-replay mutex, bounded full-replay runtime policy for large foundation archives, evidence-safe stale reservation recovery, and operational documentation for PM2 secret-metadata hygiene.
